# BookBot API

Paid agent tools for finding ebooks and audiobooks.

## Ebook endpoints (Anna's Archive)

- **POST /api/books/find** ($0.50) — Full agent: resolve an EPUB download link from a book title (and optional author) in one call.
- **POST /api/books/search** ($0.10) — Search Anna's Archive; returns up to 10 result entries with URLs.
- **POST /api/books/download-link** ($0.10) — Resolve a direct EPUB download URL from an Anna's Archive result page URL.

## Audiobook endpoints (audiobookbay.lu)

- **POST /api/audiobooks/search** ($0.005) — Search audiobookbay.lu; returns up to ~12 entries with title, slug, cover, category, language, and keywords.
- **POST /api/audiobooks/details** ($0.02) — Fetch full metadata + a magnet URI (info hash + all backup trackers) for one audiobook by slug.

## Typical flows

**Ebook**: call `/api/books/search` with `{ bookName, author? }` to list candidates, then pass a result `url` to `/api/books/download-link` for the final EPUB URL. Or skip both and call `/api/books/find` for the agent to do the full pipeline in one paid request.

**Audiobook**: call `/api/audiobooks/search` with `{ query }` to find titles, then pass a result `slug` to `/api/audiobooks/details` to get a ready-to-use magnet link.

All routes accept JSON bodies and return JSON. Unauthenticated requests receive HTTP 402 with an x402/MPP payment challenge.
